Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner set up a search strategy that included investigating "Goosebumps" (a track by Travis Scott) alongside "Goosebumpz." This introduced unnecessary ambiguity into the task by suggesting the possibility of two different artists. This could cause confusion in determining the artist associated with "Best Day Ever." While likely a precautionary measure, it was unnecessary given that "Goosebumpz" is explicitly identified as a Mac Miller song. This misdirection was compounded by repeated focus on the two tracks throughout subsequent inquiries, diverting resources from resolving the core aspects of the task directly.
